abstract: The Consumer Technology Association’s (CTA’s) standards commit tees had another product ive year. Among the many standards and informative documents they published were 15 items potentially of interest to video engineers. All documents mentioned in this article are available as free downloads at CTA.tech/Standards.

authors.bio: Mike Bergman is the vice president of technology and standards at the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), Arlington, VA where he leads association work on cybersecurity and internet standards. He has spent more than 30 years in memory chip design, wireless communications, and digital multimedia and has contributed to a number of well-known industry standards.
